extracted.name: Gingerbread Frosting for Cookies
extracted.description: Cinnamon, cloves and ginger blended into confectioners' sugar make a frosting that's perfect for snickerdoodlges, gingersnaps, or any cookie you choose.
instruction_lines: Place the confectioners' sugar in a bowl, and stir in the milk until smooth. Mix in the cinnamon, cloves, and ginger until thoroughly blended. Spread on cookies of your choice.
